	}

	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6002 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_great_port_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country

		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6003 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_giant_necropolis_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {

		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6004 }
	}
}

	}

			}
		}
	}

tv_wonder_hydraulic_workshop_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6006 }
	}
}

	}

tv_wonder_palace_of_nations_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6009 }
	}
}

		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6010 }
	}
}

				}
			}
		}
	}

tv_wonder_sky_dome_grand_temple_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6011 }
	}
}

		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_finalization_preview_ready
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 13
			var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
			tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes
			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this <= 6 }
		}
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_finalization_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair }
					prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 1 } }
				}
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 5 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 4 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 3 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 2 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value >= 5 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value >= 4 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value >= 3 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value >= 2 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 4 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 3 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value >= 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 5 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 4 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 3 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 2 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = building_type:tv_wonder_river_fair value = prev.var:tv_wonder_level }
			tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_river_extension_style_3_construct_final_building_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_finalization_preview_ready

			var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 3
			tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes

			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this <= 6 }
		}
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_finalization_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority }
					prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 1 } }
				}
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value = 5 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value = 4 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 3 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 2 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value >= 5 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value >= 4 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value >= 3 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value >= 2 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value = 4 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_canal_authority value = 3 owner = prev }

tv_wonder_river_extension_destroy_finalization_intermediate_buildings_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_module_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_extension }
				change_building_level_in_location = {
					building = building_type:tv_wonder_river_extension
					value = -6
					owner = prev
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_river_extension_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6013 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_river_extension_finalization_visible_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_finalization_preview_ready var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 13 }
		tv_wonder_apply_finalization_visible_rewards_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_river_extension_style_1_finalization_hidden_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_finalization_preview_ready var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 13 var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 1 }
		hidden_effect = {
			tv_wonder_complete_finalization_cleanup_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_river_extension_destroy_finalization_intermediate_buildings_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_river_extension_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_register_current_project_priority_candidate_from_variables_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_clear_project_state_core_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_start_concept_effect = { reason = 3 }
		}
	}
}

		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6014 }
	}
}

					value = -6
					owner = prev
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_great_wall_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6016 }
	}
}

	}

		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6018 }
	}
}

	}

		limit = {
			exists = capital

			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6020 }
	}
}

		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6022 }
	}
}

	}
}

		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6025 }
	}
}

	}

tv_wonder_royal_art_district_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {

		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6030 }
	}
}

		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6031 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_royal_mint_system_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {

		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6035 }
	}
}

			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6036 }
	}
}

	}
}

tv_wonder_city_expansion_project_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6040 }
	}
}

		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_finalization_preview_ready
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 41
			var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 1
			tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes
			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this <= 6 }
		}
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_finalization_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle }
					prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 1 } }
				}
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 5 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 4 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 3 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 2 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value >= 5 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value >= 4 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value >= 3 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value >= 2 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 4 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 3 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value >= 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 5 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 4 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 3 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 2 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = building_type:tv_wonder_solstice_gathering_circle value = prev.var:tv_wonder_level }
			tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_megalithic_circle_destroy_finalization_intermediate_buildings_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_module_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_megalithic_circle }
				change_building_level_in_location = {
					building = building_type:tv_wonder_megalithic_circle
					value = -6
					owner = prev
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_megalithic_circle_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6041 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_megalithic_circle_finalization_visible_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_finalization_preview_ready var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 41 }
		tv_wonder_apply_finalization_visible_rewards_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_megalithic_circle_style_1_finalization_hidden_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_finalization_preview_ready var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 41 var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 1 }
		hidden_effect = {
			tv_wonder_complete_finalization_cleanup_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_megalithic_circle_destroy_finalization_intermediate_buildings_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_megalithic_circle_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_register_current_project_priority_candidate_from_variables_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_clear_project_state_core_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_start_concept_effect = { reason = 3 }
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_grand_cathedral_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6042 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_great_monastery_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6043 }
	}
}

			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_sculpture_group }
				change_building_level_in_location = {

				}
			}
		}
	}

tv_wonder_great_sculpture_group_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6045 }

tv_wonder_unique_potala_palace_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6105 }
	}
}

		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_finalization_preview_ready var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 107 var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 1 }
		hidden_effect = {
			tv_wonder_complete_finalization_cleanup_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_unique_machu_picchu_destroy_finalization_intermediate_buildings_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_unique_machu_picchu_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_register_current_project_priority_candidate_from_variables_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_clear_project_state_core_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_start_concept_effect = { reason = 3 }
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_style_1_construct_final_building_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_finalization_preview_ready
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 108
			var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 1
			tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes
			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this <= 6 }
		}
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_finalization_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated }
					prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 1 } }
				}
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 5 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 4 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 3 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 2 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 4 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 3 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value >= 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 6 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 5 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 5 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 4 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 4 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 3 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 3 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 2 owner = prev }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= { this >= 2 } } }
					change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = 1 owner = prev }
				}
			}
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_inaugurated value = prev.var:tv_wonder_level }
			tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_destroy_finalization_intermediate_buildings_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_module_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle }
				change_building_level_in_location = {
					building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle
					value = -6
					owner = prev
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6108 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_himeji_castle_finalization_visible_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_finalization_preview_ready var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 108 }
		tv_wonder_apply_finalization_visible_rewards_effect = yes
	}
}

	}
}

	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_isfahan_square_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {

		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6125 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_kremlin_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6130 }
	}
}

	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country

		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital

			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6140 }
	}
}

	}

	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country

		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6150 }
	}
}

		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6162 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_sagres_navigation_school_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6167 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_calicut_port_city_destroy_finalization_intermediate_buildings_effect = {

			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_calicut_port_city }
				change_building_level_in_location = {
					building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_calicut_port_city
					value = -6
					owner = prev
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_calicut_port_city_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6177 }
	}
}

	}

	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6179 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_vilnius_university_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6184 }
	}
}

		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6194 }
	}
}

	every_country = {
		limit = {

			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6199 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_augsburg_bank_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6211 }
	}
}

			}
		}
	}

tv_wonder_unique_hanseatic_town_hall_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6214 }
	}
}

	}

			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_walls_of_benin_inaugurated value = prev.var:tv_wonder_level }
			tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_walls_of_benin_destroy_finalization_intermediate_buildings_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_module_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_walls_of_benin }
				change_building_level_in_location = {
					building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_walls_of_benin
					value = -6
					owner = prev
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_walls_of_benin_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_builder_country
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_site }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_completed_site
			NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_builder_country }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6223 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_walls_of_benin_finalization_visible_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_finalization_preview_ready var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 223 }
		tv_wonder_apply_finalization_visible_rewards_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_walls_of_benin_style_1_finalization_hidden_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_finalization_preview_ready var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 223 var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 1 }
		hidden_effect = {
			tv_wonder_complete_finalization_cleanup_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_unique_walls_of_benin_destroy_finalization_intermediate_buildings_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_unique_walls_of_benin_broadcast_finalization_completion_event_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_register_current_project_priority_candidate_from_variables_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_clear_project_state_core_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_start_concept_effect = { reason = 3 }
		}
	}
}
